name: 08a-warrior
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Vertical 9:16 original PS2 GTA San Andreas low-polygon Goji interior cutscene. Change woman's pose: she stands UPRIGHT ON TOP OF THE REFORMER'S PADDED CARRIAGE, both white socked feet on padded carriage shoulder-width apart along machine length, both arms extended straight overhead. Feet do NOT touch floor. The entire reformer is locked and STATIONARY. Therapist stands on floor to the right side beside her, a head lower because player stands on the elevated carriage; one open flat hand gently supports player's hip. Full side view showing whole machine from footbar left to shoulder blocks right, woman's complete body and raised hands not cropped, therapist complete body. Black purse and shoes on side stool. name: 08a-warrior-end
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create END POSE of same continuous locked-camera shot. Keep EXACT same reformer, carriage, footbar, shoulder blocks, frame, floor, curtain, stool, camera and therapist location. The machine must remain absolutely IDENTICAL with no moved components. Change only the maroon woman from arms overhead to a compact WARRIOR II pose STANDING ON THE SAME PADDED CARRIAGE: slide left foot a little toward footbar left and right foot toward shoulder blocks right, both white-socked feet entirely supported by the carriage cushion, neither on floor. Bend left knee comfortably toward image-left, keep right leg straight toward image-right, open torso slightly toward camera, extend both arms horizontally in opposite directions at shoulder height, palms down, gaze over left fingertips. Exactly two arms, two legs per person, low-poly hands, same maroon athleisure, black ponytail. No text. No machine motion.

name: 04-contact-exit
prompt: Precise correction of this GTA SA animation keyframe. Change woman's dark grey trousers to the SAME MAROON fitted yoga leggings as her top; white trainers on feet. Preserve pose halfway through FRONT windscreen, no duplicate body. Correct lamp post physics: its square base is ON THE PAVEMENT just IN FRONT OF the taxi's nose, NEVER on the hood. Front bumper presses hard against the vertical shaft at bumper height with small compact dent. Pole base must be visible below bumper height on ground, hood never passes through pole. Keep entire taxi the same normal size, rear and roof intact; windshield only is broken. Preserve camera, building, daylight and bystanders. Do not move the front wheels or inflate damage. One maroon woman, no blood.

name: 04-approach-final
prompt: Create PRE-IMPACT frame based on this exact GTA SA crash keyframe. Same car, maroon player, angle, lighting, pole on pavement and Lentor facade. Rewind one second: woman fully SEATED INSIDE right driver seat, no body outside, all windows INTACT, taxi front undamaged. Taxi is ALREADY MOVING and has not hit pole yet. Pull blue taxi BACK along same straight trajectory so there are 6 metres of CLEAR PAVEMENT between its FRONT bumper and pole. Move rear chase camera back with taxi to keep full car in lower-right foreground while pole appears farther ahead upper-left. Pole is static in world, not attached to taxi. Keep same elevated rear three-quarter viewing direction; no camera angle rotation. Plenty of landing space beyond pole toward storefront. Both bystanders still standing startled beside shop windows before their evasive dives. Black purse on front passenger seat, no airborne woman, no glass fragments, no smoke, no damage, no HUD. One coherent videogame still.

name: 04-landing-final
prompt: Create POST-EJECTION LANDING endpoint from this exact GTA SA crash keyframe. Keep camera, taxi geometry, lamp post, building, lighting and all environment IDENTICAL. Taxi remains stopped with front bumper touching pole, windshield broken, empty driver seat. Move the ONE maroon woman from halfway through windshield to pavement BEYOND AND LEFT of pole, closer to mall storefront, ALL of her body clear of car and pole. She has just finished a harmless tumble and is ON HANDS AND KNEES, ready to push herself up and run toward glass mall doors. White trainers and maroon leggings same as top, ponytail. Her black purse lies within reach of her right hand. Keep her whole body visible inside frame; no second woman in car. All glass fragments settled. Two passersby on left/right recover from diving aside, alive unhurt. No blood, no pain, no sprawled corpse-like pose. Camera does not change. Taxi doesn't move or rotate. Use clear spatial continuity.

name: 09-squat
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a vertical 9:16 original 2004 GTA San Andreas PS2 low-polygon interior cutscene. Image1 is user-supplied squat-rack equipment and room-layout reference, image2 defines our fictional maroon yoga woman and navy female Goji physiotherapist and game rendering style. Model the exact black MATRIX free-weight squat rack from image1: two black perforated uprights, silver cross beam and pull-up bar, horizontal safety arms, black base feet, silver barbell, green and blue weight plates stored on right pegs, large mirror behind, dark rubber floor. IMPORTANT replace the entire tall left-side open window with built-in light oak open SHELVING holding neatly folded towels and small exercise props; no left window or outdoor view. Remove every real man and photographer from reference. Our young adult maroon sleeveless top/leggings woman, black ponytail and white trainers, stands inside rack facing mirror with modest loaded bar resting on upper back, hands gripping it symmetrically, feet shoulder width, knees slightly bent at start of squat. Same adult navy female physiotherapist stands directly behind and slightly offset so both are visible, knees soft, hands open close to player's lateral ribs ready to spot without grabbing bar; therapist watches player's torso. Simple mitten-like low-poly hands with no doubled fingers. Rear-three-quarter interior cutscene camera, wide full-body frame including rack top and feet and BOTH characters, reflection consistent with two characters only. Calm soft warm clinic light, charcoal rubber floor, muted cream walls, maroon mat optional none. Black purse on side shelf. NO real reference people, no photographer, no excessive plates, no text overlays or HUD. Keep PS2 angular faces and simplified textures, not photorealistic.
